lines.en: I guess I’ll give Kirin a call.
I’ve sort of been sitting on her number ever since she gave it to me, and she seems...normal enough to hang out with.
Okay, well, maybe 'normal' isn’t the right word.
If anything, she’s actually kind of abnormal.
But it’s the good kind of abnormal.
The kind that makes me feel like she’ll be down to sleep with me after hanging out a few times.
And it’s not wrong for me to say that, either, since this was basically her idea.
I’m just a totally normal teacher who can’t help but do whatever’s possible to make his students happy.
And, uhh, other students, I guess. Because Kirin isn’t really my responsibility.
What am I even talking about right now? I should just call her before she winds up doing something else.
I press on Kirin’s name in my contact menu and wait for her to pick up.
: Hihi~ Whatcha up to, Sensei? Bored on your day off?
: I guess so. Just looking for something to do.
: Cool, cool.
: Wanna come over?
Woah. Already?
: Really? Your parents aren’t home?
: Nope! They’re not here much anyway.
: And your sister?
: Mmm...I think she’s out with Miku? I can’t really remember.
: And she’s not planning on coming back any time soon?
: What’s with all the questions? Do you wanna come over or not?
: Sure. Where do you live?
: Do you know where Pepper-Lunch is?
: Pepper what?
: Getting fired at your age probably isn’t going to look good on future applications.
: Ehh, it’s whatever. That job was super boring anyway.
: Just look up the address of that place and meet me there in like...half an hour. Kay?
: I’ll walk you to my house and stuff.
: Sure thing. See you then.
: Byeeee~
After hanging up, I punch in the address to Pepper-Lunch in my phone and begin to make my way there...
I show up in front of the restaurant to find Kirin already waiting there.
She’s probably only been here for a few minutes anyway.
Kirin pulls herself off of the wall and skips over to me as I approach her.
: Hey! Find the place okay?
: It was easy enough.
: I’ve been around here before, so I more or less knew where I was going.
: Maybe a little confusing at first, but once I figured out the streets were numbered it was fine.
: Well I’m glad you made it. I felt like I was gonna die if I had to sit around the stupid house all day.
: Do you...not have any friends or something?
: Of course I have friends...What is that supposed to mean?
: I don’t know. I just figured that if you did, you’d be hanging out with them instead of, you know, a teacher.
: I was actually thinking about texting a few of ‘em, but then I saw your number show up and was like “ehh, screw it.”
: And now here we are, in front of the place that fired me for not showing up to one or two shifts.
: Not to take sides here, but I’m pretty sure that’s a good reason to fire someone.
: Right, right. Cause you know all about doing stuff that can get you fired, don’t you, Sensei?
: Of course! You’re very welcome~
: Are you, uhh, sure you’re ready to come over, though? I figured you’d be kinda hesitant after our talk in your office.
: Why would you think that? I literally agreed to help you ditch[school] in exchange for sex during that same conversation.
: That's...kind of vulgar. I don't really think I'd go that far.
: I’m obviously not the best when it comes to expressing emotions, but I can assure you I was very much excited.
: I especially liked the part where you showed me your underwear. That was cool and you should do it again.
: Bossing me around already? We’re not even alone yet, Sensei.
: So it’s okay to boss you around once we are?
: Hehe~ Maybe not today. I’ve still gotta size you up and stuff.
: Like, measure my penis?
: What? No. It’s a phrase.
: Oh. I, uhh, think that might be a problem then. But I’ll do my best.
: You don’t really have to do anything you normally wouldn’t. I mean like, we’ll be alone, so stuff might just happen naturally.
: That’s how this sort of thing goes, right?
: A guy and a girl hang out alone. Hands wind up going where they’re not supposed to go. Blah blah blah, orgasms, so on and so forth.
: That...was a really weird sentence. But I think I know where you were going with it.
: It’s kind of weird to hear you talk like that, though.
: Weird? Why? You barely even know me.
That’s...a good point.
It’s like she’s another Ayane. And two Ayane’s in the same dimension sounds kind of intimidating.
: It’s just odd hearing stuff like that from someone other than Ayane.
: Ohhhh. Is that so?...
: Why do you look so pissed off now?
: I’m not pissed off.
: Just...follow me.
: I’ll show you where the apartment is...
Kirin’s anger(?) winds up fading away just moments later.
From the sound of it, she’s lived in this same area her entire life.
I wonder what it is that turned her into who she is now?
Or, at least, what she seems to be.
The whole thing about not knowing her is sticking in my head a lot more than I thought it would...
: I’m home~
Kirin calls out to absolutely no one and takes her shoes off, leaving them in the entryway.
I’d actually be rather impressed by the place if it wasn’t also the size of a large shoebox.
: Does your entire family really live here?
: Hm? Yeah. What do you mean?
I join Kirin, who’s already taken a seat on the couch, and continue on with my train of thought.
: It just seems kind of small for four people. Do you and Karin share a room?
: Technically, yeah. I normally just sleep on the couch, though.
: You sleep on the couch in your own home?
: Yeah. Karin talks in her sleep sometimes and it gets really weird.
: She talks? About what?
: Sports stuff, I guess? Nothing interesting or sexy or anything like that.
: I see.
: What? Boring answer? Did you think she might be saying stuff about you or something?
: Not really, no. Was just hoping for something a little more entertaining.
: Yeah. I can relate to that.
: Life can get pretty boring sometimes, huh?
: It’s not that bad.
: Says the guy with a harem of [high_school] girls.
: Okay, so it’s not that bad for me.
: What do you have to be bored of, though? Isn’t this like, the prime of your life?
: It’s supposed to be. I just feel like nothing ever happens around here anymore.
: Yeah, the city’s closed off and stuff, but that’s not really what I’m talking about.
: It’s like, everything I try doing I only do to be around other people. Nothing’s ever fun.
: And so a lot of the time I just wind up sitting at home reading or like, watching porn or whatever.
What kind of books do you like?
: Interesting. You didn’t really strike me as a reader.
: Is that an insult?
: No, of course not. There’s nothing wrong with reading.
: That’s not what your face says...
: Well I can’t see my face, so I’m no help there...but what kind of books are you into?
: I see...
Porn?!?!?! I LOVE porn!
I suddenly feel the urge to yell about my love for porn, but decide to suppress my desires and inquire normally.
: It’s not weird watching porn in the room with your sister?
: Well, she’s out all the time so it’s not like I’m never alone.
: And I normally just use my phone anyway so I can hide under the blanket and...
: Please go on.
: Naaaah. Not today...
An awkward silence suddenly finds its way next to us on the couch, changing the air in the room for a brief moment in time.
I can’t tell if Kirin feels comfortable or uncomfortable. To me, she just seems weird.
Like she’s got some type of shell up that she’s trying to crack and glue back together at the same time.
: Hey.
: Something’s been bugging me and I feel like I’m gonna get annoyed if I don’t ask you. Is that cool?
: Sure. There aren’t many questions I have trouble answering. Sometimes, a window even pops up to help me choose.
: A what now?
: Nothing. Please just ask me your question.
: Well, okay. But you have to be honest about it.
: Sure.
: Okay, so, uhhh-
: You’re not like, in love with anybody, are you?
: You’re just messing around with a bunch of girls for the fun of it, right?
: Am I allowed to ask a question as well?
: I guess. You have to answer mine first, though.
: Well, in that case-
I don’t know how I feel
: I don’t really know how I feel.
: I don’t tend to think about love or romance or anything like that. And I guess it would be weird for someone in my position to do that.
: But it’s not like I’m opposed.
: I’m just not really sure if I’m capable of feeling something that extreme right now.
: Hmm...Okay. I guess that makes sense.
: Kind of a boring answer, but not a bad one.
I’m just trying to have fun
: I’m just trying to have some fun.
: Gotta give us girls what we want, don’t you, Sensei?
: That’s basically my mission in life, yeah.
: Well at least you’re up front about it. People that dance around their feelings really piss me off.
: It’s like, if you want to do it, just do it. Right? What’s the point of getting all weird about it?
: That’s like, the one thing I really respect about Ayane.
: She saw what she wanted in you and she took it.
I think it’s closer to me taking her, but I guess I see where Kirin is coming from.
: Ayane hasn’t taken anything. I’m a free man.
: Right. Like I’m gonna believe that. Didn’t you just say you were trying to have fun?
: Well, yeah...But-
: Basically, all I’m trying to say is that I think we should do whatever we want to do, whenever we want to do it.
: That being said-
: Can I ask my question now?
: Yeah, I guess you humored me well enough. What’s up?
: Okay, well-
: Are you sure you’re ready to lose your virginity?
: Because I want to say you are, but there are a few things about the way you act that confuse me.
: Huh? What are you talking about? I've been dropping hints for like the past hour. What would make you think I’m not ready?
: Well, I kind of expected things to lead to that today, and all we’ve really done is sit on the couch and just...talk about stuff.
: I’m not disappointed by that, don’t get me wrong. It’s just weird when you’re so forward about it one minute and then don’t actually do anything about it.
: You say all these things about just 'doing whatever we want,' but it's like you're not even taking your own advice.
: Ugh...It's really annoying when you put it that way.
: And it's even more annoying cause I know you're right.
: I definitely do wanna do it...
: I just...
: ...can’t right now.
: Ooooooooooooh...
: Yup.
: Woe is me for being born with two X chromosomes.
: Please forget everything you may have thought up in the last five minutes before I die of embarrassment and regret.
: Done. I’ve already forgotten everything.
: Okay, good.
: I really...
: Do want to try it soon, though...
: Is that weird? Wanting to do it with someone you barely know?
: Or someone so much older?
: I kind of just threw out the idea in your office because I felt like it might be easy to get you to do something for me, but-
: The more I think about it, the more I start actually getting excited.
: Sooooo yeah. That's weird, right?
: I don’t think it's weird at all...Life is all about having fun, isn’t it?
: Right. That's exactly what life is all about.
: I just wish everything wasn’t so boring.
: Amen.
: So, what do you say, Sensei?
: Are you willing to be my partner in crime?
: Do you wanna watch the rest of the world burn while we fuck like rabbits in my parents' bed?
: I don’t think I’ve ever been this turned on by a single sentence before.
: Heheh~ Well hopefully I break that record again sometime in the future.
Okay, then.
First date with Kirin was a complete success.
I think.
A lot of what she says is still a little hard for me to interpret...But it’s the rationale behind everything that confuses me even more.
I feel like it might be a while before I truly understand her.
Kirin and I wind up watching something on TV for the next couple hours before Karin tells her she’s on the way home.
Not wanting to start a feud or misunderstanding between the two of them, I decide it’s best to leave.
Kirin asks me to stay, but I’m pretty sure she just wants to make her sister jealous.
Here’s hoping I can see more of her in the future.
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
